programme.title: MacGyver
programme.desc: Ein alter Bekannter von Jack und Matty ist plötzlich wieder auf der Bildfläche aufgetaucht: Emil Beck, ein ehemaliger Regierungsangestellter, der vor vielen Jahren Geheiminformationen stahl und danach untergetaucht ist. Das Team soll Beck nun schnappen, doch der ist seinen Verfolgern scheinbar immer einen Schritt voraus. Noch dazu hat es Mama Coltons Kopfgeldjäger-Truppe ebenfalls auf den lukrativen Fang abgesehen und macht Mac & Co.das Leben schwer. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: MacGyver
programme.desc: Dawn sitzt völlig aufgelöst in Jacks Wohnung. Ihr Chef bei der CIA kam bei einem Autounfall ums Leben, sie vermutet allerdings Mord: Kurz vor seinem Tod hatte ihr Paul erzählt, dass jemand von der CIA offenbar falsche Pässe ausstellt, um Menschen illegal ins Land zu holen. Phoenix geht der Sache nach und stellt fest, dass Dawns Vermutung richtig war. Nun müssen nicht nur die illegal Eingeschleusten gefunden, sondern auch der Maulwurf enttarnt werden – ein riskantes Unterfangen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: MacGyver
programme.desc: Es gibt eine neue Spur zu dem EMP, das Phoenix durch Rileys Versagen im entscheidenden Moment durch die Lappen gegangen ist: Es soll in Seoul den Besitzer wechseln. Das Team macht sich auf die Reise, muss die Käufer allerdings bis Shanghai verfolgen. Dort will eine Elite-Söldnertruppe um den Ex-Soldaten Morales die Elektronik eines Hochhauses lahmlegen, um an das Vermögen des Milliardärs Ralph Jericho zu kommen. Doch das ist nicht das eigentliche Ziel der Kriminellen ... (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: Der exzentrische Engländer Sherlock Holmes hat in New York erfolgreich einen Drogenentzug absolviert und arbeitet seitdem als Berater für das NYPD. Sein Boss, Captain Tobias Gregson, fürchtet jedoch, dass Holmes' außergewöhnliche Art, Verbrechen aufzuklären, in seiner Behörde zu Problemen führen könnte. Die Ärztin Dr. Joan Watson soll den Ex-Junkie betreuen. Als sie Holmes zu seiner Arbeit begleitet, stellt sie fest, dass ihr Ermittlungsarbeit mehr liegt, als sie gedacht hat. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: Ridley Dineen, ein Dieb, der seinen Lebensunterhalt dadurch bestreitet, andere Kriminelle zu beklauen, wird ermordet in seinem Bett gefunden. Holmes und Watson untersuchen den Fall. Als sie den Inhalator des Opfers gegen seine Allergie finden, stellen sie fest, dass das Gerät mit fentanylhaltigem Gas gefüllt ist. Sherlock sieht hier eine Parellele zu einem Gas, das 2002 von den Russen bei der Geiselnahme in einem Moskauer Theater gegen tschetschenische Rebellen eingesetzt wurde. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Bones – Die Knochenjägerin
programme.desc: Booth und Brennan werden zu einer Leiche gerufen, die in einem ausgebrannten Truck gefunden wurde. Doch die Untersuchung der Überreste zeigt, dass das Opfer weder durch das Feuer, noch an der Schusswunde starb, die ihm kurz vor seinem Tod zugefügt wurde. Da die Ehefrau des Toten, Kathy Lyford, vor kurzem eine hohe Lebensversicherung auf ihn abgeschlossen hat, gerät sie ins Visier der Ermittler ... (Senderinfo).

programme.title: ATV Aktuell
programme.desc: Die Nachrichten, über die Österreich spricht – top-aktuell und informativ. Die ATV-Reporter stellen die Fragen, auf die Sie eine Antwort wollen. Der perfekte Nachrichtenmix präsentiert von Meinrad Knapp, Sylvia Saringer, Jenny Laimer und Benedikt Gmeiner. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Bones – Die Knochenjägerin
programme.desc: Die forensische Anthropologin Dr. Temperance Brennan – genannt "Bones" – ist eine brillante Wissenschaftlerin, die gemeinsam mit dem Ermittler Seeley Booth am Jeffersonian Institute in Washington Mordfälle und Verbrechen untersucht, in denen meist nur ein paar Knochen übrig sind. So erfolgreich sie in ihrem Job ist – ihr Privatleben stellt sie immer wieder vor neue Herausforderungen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Leonard und Sheldon sind brillante Physiker, die meist zusammen mit ihren Kumpels Howard und Rajesh in ihrem gemeinsamen Apartment abhängen und – natürlich nach einem festgelegten Plan – ihre Videogames pflegen. Einzig und allein Penny, die neue Nachbarin, schafft es hin und wieder, für Abwechslung zu sorgen. Sie hat zwar keine Ahnung von Physik, doch kennt sie die Welt da draußen – etwas, was den Physikern vollkommen fremd zu sein scheint ... (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Penny erwartet eine Möbellieferung, kann allerdings zum angegebenen Zeitpunkt nicht zu Hause sein, und so bittet sie Leonard und Sheldon um Hilfe. Kaum mit dem Regal in ihrem Apartment angekommen, überkommt Sheldon die Putzwut – Pennys Wohnung ist ein einziger Saustall! Leonard kann ihn erst bremsen, als Penny zurückkommt. Mitten in der Nacht hört Leonard Geräusche von nebenan: Sheldon ist mit Hilfe des Ersatzschlüssels in die Wohnung eingetreten und räumt weiter auf ... (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Leonard und Sheldon lernen auf einer Party ihren neuen Chef kennen. Sheldon kann sich mal wieder nicht zurückhalten und steckt seinem Vorgesetzten, was er von ihm hält – nämlich nichts. Als Sheldon daraufhin seinen Job verliert, nimmt er sich endlich Zeit für Experimente, die er schon immer einmal durchführen wollte. Nach leuchtenden Fischen ist nun der Webstuhl dran. Leonard platzt der Kragen! Nur eine Person kann Sheldon jetzt noch zur Besinnung bringen: seine Mutter Mary ... (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Penny hat Leonard und Leslie gemeinsam gesehen und fragt ihn, ob die beiden ein Paar seien. Leonard verneint dies vehement, doch ein Schäferstündchen mit Leslie kann er nicht leugnen. Als ihm Leslie allerdings klarmacht, dass es sich um eine einmalige Sache handelt, ist er zutiefst verletzt. Er ärgert sich so sehr, dass er gar nicht mitbekommt, wie glücklich Penny darüber ist, dass zwischen ihm und Leslie nichts läuft. Und auch Sheldon macht eine aufregende Entdeckung ... (Senderinfo).

programme.title: How I Met Your Mother
programme.desc: Barmann Dough ist für seine Loyalität gegenüber seinen Stammgästen im McLaren's bekannt. Das bekommen auch Ted und seine Freunde zu spüren, als ihr Stammtisch besetzt ist. Gegen ihren Willen räumt Dough rigoros für sie den Tisch, verabredet sich mit den Typen draußen zu einer Schlägerei und fordert Ted und seine Freunde auf, ihm zu helfen. Das Duell endet jedoch anders als gedacht ... Schließlich ist es der als Weichei verspottete Marshall, der als Sieger aus der Runde geht ... (Senderinfo).

programme.title: How I Met Your Mother
programme.desc: Ted Mosby erzählt im Jahr 2030 seinen Kindern alle Details darüber, wie er seine Frau kennengelernt hat. Seine Erläuterungen beginnen im Jahr 2005, als sich Ted als Architekturstudent eine Wohnung mit seinem Freund Marshall teilt. Kurze Zeit später lernt Ted die Nachrichtensprecherin Robin kennen und lieben. Sie will jedoch von einer festen Beziehung noch gar nichts wissen ... Völlig unklar ist deshalb, welche der Frauen an Teds Seite nun die Mutter seiner Kinder wird. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: How I Met Your Mother
programme.desc: Teds Ex Robin ist zu ihm gezogen und seitdem streiten sie sich ständig wegen ihrer Schlampigkeit. Sie kommen zu dem Schluss, dass ihnen der Sex fehlt, der früher ihre Spannungen gelöst hat. Also beschließen sie, wieder damit anzufangen. Barney, der ein großes Problem hat, gesteht Lily seine Gefühle für Robin ... Marshall hingegen hat ein ganz anderes Problem: Seine Angewohnheit, täglich mit einer Zeitschrift die Toilette aufzusuchen, wird in seiner neuen Firma zum Problem ... (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Have I Got News for You
Film: The Preacher's Wife
programme.desc:
Reverend Biggs (Courtney B. Vance) ist verzweifelt: Seine Kirche muss renoviert werden, seine Gemeindemitglieder haben auch schon bessere Zeiten erlebt, außerdem steht das Weihnachtsfest vor der Tür. Darüber hinaus fühlt sich Gattin Julia (Whitney Houston) vernachlässigt. Kurzum: Der Geistliche ist mit seinem Latein am Ende und sendet ein Stoßgebet zum Himmel, das prompt erhört wird. 

Die Hilfe wird in Gestalt des schwarzen Engels Dudley (Denzel Washington) geschickt. Eifrig macht dieser sich ans Werk und geht dem gestressten Reverend erst mal gehörig auf die Nerven. Nicht zuletzt, weil er sich mehr als nötig der unglücklichen Pastorengattin annimmt. 

Süßer können die Glocken nun wirklich nicht klingen als in Penny Marshalls Remake des Cary-Grant-Films „Jede Frau braucht einen Engel“ (1947).

programme.title: Film: The Lady in the Van
programme.desc: Zwischen all den blitzenden Fassaden und gepflegten Gärten ist der klapprige Van der obdachlosen Mary Shepherd ein Ärgernis. Nur Bühnenautor Alan Bennett hat ein Herz und gestattet Mary, ihr fahrendes Zuhause vorübergehend in seiner Einfahrt zu parken. Daraus werden 15 Jahre und eine Freundschaft. Die Grantlerin hat Maggie Smith einfach drauf. \n\nNur wenige können in einen Gesichtsausdruck so viel Trotz, Provokation und Schroffheit legen wie die zweifache Oscar-Preisträgerin, die auch dieser Independent-Perle ihren Stempel aufdrückt. Smith spielte die Figur bereits im Theaterstück von Alan Bennett, der die Geschichte tatsächlich erlebte. Gedreht wurde sozusagen am Originalschauplatz: in Bennetts Einfahrt.

programme.title: The Finish Line
programme.desc: Roman Kemp, assisted by Sarah Greene, hosts the quiz show where contestants race in moving podiums across the studio floor. Correct answers get the players moving, while wrong answers will stop them in their tracks. Five contestants – Laura, Olu, Jack, Jane, Luke – battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple – make it to the finish line before your rivals. The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the £5,000 cash prize. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: MasterChef: The Professionals
programme.desc: Five chefs remain in the race for a place in the quarter-final. But two more high-pressure challenges, which test every aspect of their cooking, stand in their way. Marcus and Monica are joined by special guest Adejoké Bakare, whose restaurant Chishuru is at the forefront of west African fine dining. In 2024, Adejoké became the first black woman in the UK to be awarded a coveted Michelin star. Now she's setting the chefs a dish from her own repertoire: mushroom moin moin, served with a shito sauce and steamed egg. It may sound simple, but this deceptively complex dish is packed with unfamiliar ingredients, techniques and flavours, and only one of the chefs has ever cooked moin moin before. With no recipe to follow, they have to rely entirely on their palates, instincts and technical skills to recreate Adejoké's dish. But with a place in the quarter-final on the line, get it wrong and the consequences could be huge. Next up, it all comes down to dessert. The chefs have one last opportunity to convince Marcus and Monica that they deserve to stay in the competition. But pastry is an unforgiving business. Every element must be precise, every second counts, and even the smallest mistake can unravel a dish. The judges want more than technical perfection... they're looking for personality, originality and a dessert that leaves a lasting impression. Who can hold their nerve when it matters most? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc: Game show in which 24 players compete to score points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day. In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the quiz show where a team of four take on the Bridge of Lies. This time, it's four members of the same family, Susan, Chris, Anthony and Mark. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will halve their money, step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
programme.desc: Sean Fletcher and Edith Bowman search for tips and treats from food producers as they explore Leicester Market, with masterclasses in fajitas and gelato. Ryan Hand discovers why some snacks in our shops seem to be shrinking, and Michela Chiappa reveals what makes a perfect coffee. Chef Julie Lin is on a mission to discover the story behind Scotland's square sausages. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo explores the wild and rugged coastline of Northumberland by rail. He begins today in Morpeth, where he finds a historic collection of Northumbrian bagpipes and discovers how difficult they are to play. The East Coast Main Line delivers Michael to Widdrington and its long sandy bay, where a beachcombing blacksmith finds treasures to inspire artwork in steel. Michael helps to put the finishing touches on a metal seaweed design. At Rothbury, Michael visits Britain's first smart home: a gadget-filled Victorian mansion built by wealthy industrialist and inventor, William Armstrong. Cragside clings to the side of a mountain and is full of such 19th-century mod cons as an early dishwasher, a water-powered roasting spit, central heating and hydroelectricity. Heading back to the sea, Michael reaches the mouth of the River Coquet and the fishing port of Amble, home to one of the largest fleets of inshore fishing boats on this coast. An innovative scheme to promote ugly fish challenges his taste buds. Can he resist a red gurnard risotto? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Liz Bonnin's Wild Caribbean
programme.desc: In Central America, the crystal-clear waters of the Caribbean Sea meet jungle landscapes that support an extraordinary array of wildlife. It's a perfect habitat that houses the highest density of some of the world's most endangered animals. In Belize, Liz goes on the trail of a jaguar that's suspected of stealing local pigs, joins local scientists in a high-adrenaline expedition to tag Antillean manatees, and meets the inspirational women who have increased the population of Yucatan black howler monkeys by ten times. Travelling on to Costa Rica, Liz meets a man who took an enormous risk by turning his father's farm into a haven for frogs, encounters a remarkable woman ensuring that the local wildlife thrives as her hometown grows, and discovers how to rehabilitate sloths, helping two of them to return to the wild. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team are in Norwich where, in the cathedral cloisters, they uncover more treasures. Items include original illustrations to the childhood classic Black Beauty, a rare saucer used for many years as an ashtray and valued at £1,000, and fragments of porcelain which act as a poignant reminder of the events that destroyed Hiroshima in World War II. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Antiques series. The team visit the magnificent Stockport Town Hall in Greater Manchester. Paul Martin is joined by experts Mark Stacey and Philip Serrell in picking out a selection of their favourite antiques to be filmed at auction. Philip spies a collection of evocative war diaries, while Mark falls for a mosaic necklace-and-earring set that surprises everyone at auction. Paul also takes time out to explore the history behind Stockport air-raid shelters. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: New: House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Catherine Bohart, Chesney Hawkes, Rebecca Keatley and Jason Mohammad take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, Michael Sheen. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games wheelie luggage, or will they be tempted by the House of Games skateboard? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Strictly It Takes Two
programme.desc: Ellie Taylor gets all the unmissable news from inside the training rooms for the first time this week as the celebs prepare for their Week 10 dances. Also, this week's pro panel are in studio to break down all the Blackpool week performances. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing.
programme.desc: Paul and Bob travel to County Tyrone to fish at Baronscourt Estate, hoping to catch a pike of a lifetime. They have access to two beautiful and secluded loughs, set in over 130 acres of rolling countryside, and the private use of one rowing boat – what could possibly go wrong? Pike are wily fish, always hiding in the dark reeds and waiting to ambush their prey. Bob has a fail-safe method to try, but will the duo be able to outwit the elusive creatures? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Researchers estimate that another billion people will be online within the next five years, joining a growing community of internet users that already numbers five billion. The majority of these newcomers will be from developing nations in southern Asia and Africa. Professor Hannah Fry learns about what this influx will mean for the future of the internet. How will these new users embrace this technology to transform their lives, and what will it mean for the rest of the world? Will a truly democratic online community finally be achieved, with the internet serving humanity for good, offering increased educational access and greater cultural exchange? Or will this bridging of the digital divide signal user-generated chaos? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Secret Genius of Modern Life: The Best Bits.
programme.desc: The rollercoaster has been sending our hearts racing and stomachs dropping for over a century, and today, millions of us get our kicks on these topsy-turvy, daredevil joyriders. Hannah gets the inside story on the UK's newest, tallest and fastest rollercoaster – Thorpe Park's Hyperia. She uncovers the wild origins of the modern-day coaster and finds out how some dodgy French physics in the 19th century, Nasa rocket scientists and an ambitious cartoonist called Walt delivered the ultimate thrill machine. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: First into the barn, Gwyneth from Powys entrusts painting conservator Lucia with a remarkable but badly bruised portrait of her heroic ancestor Captain William Marshall, who risked his life to rescue over 100 shipwrecked Irish emigrants left stranded on an iceberg. The portrait was the precious possession of her late son Paul, who bore an extraordinary resemblance to his six-times great-grandfather, but the ravages of time have left it bent and buckled, with key elements, including the captain's handsome features, obscured beneath yellowing varnish. After hours of painstaking repair work, Lucia welcomes Gwyneth back to the barn, on what would have been Paul's birthday, to reveal the extraordinary results of her restoration. Next, woodworker Will, bookbinder Chris and textiles conservator Rebecca join forces to rescue a well-travelled Jamaican trunk, otherwise known as a grip, that has seen far better days. Brought into the barn by Raphaelia Finlayson, the grip accompanied her father Aubrey, a singer, songwriter and record producer, all over the world as he travelled between Jamaica, London and the USA in pursuit of his musical dreams. Towards the end of Aubrey's life, the battered wooden case held the vinyl records, sheet music and memorabilia of a lifetime spent in music, but now, damaged by decades of travel and storage, its wood is warped, its fabric is torn, and its paper lining has disintegrated. Will, Chris and Rebecca are determined to return the grip to its former glory, allowing Raphaelia to preserve her father's mini museum and the legacy of his creative journey. From Perth in Scotland, Andy brings a shattered plaster bust that for 20 years held pride of place in the family home he shared with his late wife, Diane. The bust originally caught the couple's eye at a car boot sale because Andy felt it looked just like Diane, and it had sat proudly in their hallway ever since. However, an unfortunate accident saw it smashed to pieces, and ceramics restorer Kirsten Ramsay now faces the ultimate 3D jigsaw. Can she reassemble hundreds of fragments of plaster and bring the features so reminiscent of Diane back to life? Finally, silversmith Brenton West takes on the intricate repair of a 1950s boxing trophy, brought in by Amanda from County Durham and awarded to her late father, Tommy Dixon, at the Royal Albert Hall, to commemorate the first time he fought for his country. Years of childhood play at the hands of Amanda and her brothers have left the tiny silver boxing ring bent, broken and tarnished. It takes all of Brenton's considerable skills to get it back to its best as he fabricates new rope holders, retwists brass wire into perfect miniature ropes and silver-plates every surface. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Murder Case: Fire in the Suburbs
programme.desc: January 2017. Police continue their investigation into the murder of 23-year-old Cameron Logan, who died in a fire at his family home in Milngavie, near Glasgow. Bex Williams has suffered severe injuries in the fire that killed her boyfriend, but at last she is well enough to provide police with vital information about what happened on New Year's Day. From her hospital bed, she recalls the horror of what she saw and heard during the attack, but she is unable to identify the masked intruder. With the murderer still at large, detectives must look elsewhere for answers. Their attention turns to Cameron's older brother Blair, and they discover the brothers had not always seen eye to eye. But could a family fall out really have led to such violent and deadly consequences? Blair tells police he was out jogging on the morning of the fire, and only returned when the emergency services were arriving. Could his absence simply be a coincidence, or is there more to his movements that morning? Working alongside their forensic colleagues, detectives revisit the house, and they finally find a key piece of evidence that enables them to name a suspect. Bex begins the long process of recovery and grief, and speaking in a documentary for the first time, she details how she worked through the physical and emotional impact of the fire. With so much against her, Bex shows extraordinary strength and is determined to find justice for Cameron. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Highland Cops
programme.desc: On Skye, police race to a hotel where a barman has been violently assaulted. CCTV captures the shocking attack, but the suspect has fled and officers must track him down. In Inverness, police prepare to raid a house suspected of links to a Liverpool drugs gang. And on the Western Isles, officers race to a reported home invasion in a remote village, only to discover that all is not as it seems. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: A Course Called Ireland
programme.desc: After weeks of travelling, filming and constant attention, life on the road is taking its toll on Bill. With brothers Joel and Johnny along for the ride, family offers an escape from fame. The Murrays reflect on losing their father young, and how caddying and golf bound nine siblings together. By the time they reach Cruit Island in Donegal, family reflection gives way to golfing rivalry. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Witch Farm
programme.desc: Summer 1989. Looking for a fresh start, Bill and his pregnant partner Liz move to a remote farmhouse in idyllic Bannau Brycheiniog with his teenage son Jonathan. Yet on the very first night, Liz hears footsteps on the landing. Before long, she and Jonathan are sharing disturbing dreams. And as strange events intensify, Bill and Liz are forced to accept a terrifying new reality. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Witch Farm
programme.desc: The family receive a shockingly high electricity bill, and their animals start to behave oddly. Liz meets spiritualist Bethan at a mother and baby group. After a strained Christmas dinner, Jonathan admits he's also seen a ghost. Liz and Bill beg Brecon Council for help, raising the suspicions of social services. Bethan offers to conduct a seance, leading to a shocking conclusion. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Cunk on Cinema
programme.desc: Philomena Cunk continues her epic journey deep, deep into film. She interrogates some of the world's foremost filmmakers and critics, discovers an age of screen icons, from Marilyn Monroe to Wayne John, learns how Hollywood movies changed as American social values relaxed, and discovers how, believe it or not, other countries were making films as well. Along the way, she gives her verdict on classics like Jaws, Taxi Driver, and Citizen Ken – very much the Citizen Kane of films about people called Ken. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: Paris is home to more award-winning pastry chefs than anywhere else in the world. Here, the day revolves around patisserie. Morning begins with the buttery flakes of a croissant. At midday, a baguette tucked under the arm signals lunch. And by the afternoon, mouthwatering sweet treats are savoured like miniature works of art. Resistance is futile, and Eva is seduced by the Paris-Brest, a rum baba, the macaron, a mango cake and dahlia, to name just a few. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Nicki Chapman is in glorious Gloucestershire with Sam and Mandy, who are moving from a harbour town in Devon and making a fresh start in the countryside, with their two much-loved dogs coming along for the adventure. With £475,000 to spend, Nicki serves up a terrific selection of homes, but it's the mystery house that really raises the stakes, with views so spectacular they feel like they're standing on top of the world. From one grand outlook to another, Nicki gets an exclusive invitation to experience horticulture on a truly regal scale when she visits a garden quite literally fit for a king. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Finish Line
programme.desc: Roman Kemp, assisted by Sarah Greene, hosts the quiz show where contestants race in moving podiums across the studio floor. Correct answers get the players moving, while wrong answers will stop them in their tracks. Five contestants – Philippa, Nathan, Pete, Natalie and Sandra – battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple – make it to the finish line before your rivals. The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the £5,000 cash prize. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty celebrates the rewards of winter gardening – sharing ideas, inspiration and timely jobs to keep gardeners busy now, while reminding us that warmer days lie ahead. At Longmeadow, he has hellebores to plant, peas to sow and practical advice on propagating roses. Sue Kent gets to work on her allotment, where there's always plenty to do during the colder months, including some clever composting. Jamie Butterworth takes a tour of one of Somerset's most imaginative topiary gardens. In Belfast, a local community tells the tale of how their once neglected alleyway has become their pride and joy. Carol Klein unearths some radical new thinking on how flowers may be adapting to climate change, while Rekha Mistry travels to RHS Garden Bridgewater to see how garden varieties of tomato and mint are put to the test. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc: Game show in which 24 players compete to score points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day. In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the quiz show where a team of four take on the Bridge of Lies. This time, it's four members of the same family, Sarah, Paul, Curtis and Jessica. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will halve their money, step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
programme.desc: Colin Murray and Edith Bowman discover tips and treats at the food and music festival in Newcastle. They find out how to create award-winning burgers and reveal the secrets of chips, French-Canadian style. Briony May Williams goes on the trail of the nation's favourite herb, and chef Julie Lin sets sail to find Scotland's most valuable fish. Farmer Meinir Howells investigates the growing popularity of keeping chickens. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo travels the length of the magnificent Northumbrian coastline with its glorious beaches and grandiose castles. In the village of Alnmouth, he takes to the waves in a traditional skiff built by dedicated members of the Alnmouth Coastal Rowing Club. They're training to compete in the World Championships in a boat based on a design from Fair Isle. Michael has to learn fast to stay afloat. The Aln Valley heritage railway conveys Michael to Alnwick, crossing a 170-year-old viaduct built by Robert Stephenson. From the historic cobbled town with its imposing castle, Michael heads for the beach at Boulmer to hear about threats to this low-lying coastline and efforts to protect it from sea erosion and tidal surges. Next stop for Michael is Chathill, which serves the 19th-century port of Seahouses, from which boats depart for the Farne Islands. Along this rocky coastline, Michael heads for the Olde Ship Inn to discover a fascinating map which charts the wrecks of many ships. The mighty Bamburgh Castle, icon of Northumberland, is Michael's last destination today. Once the seat of Northumbrian kings, the castle building was begun by the Normans, and since the late 19th century, has been in the hands of the Armstrong family. Michael meets the castle's current keeper to hear about its history and admire its magnificent King's Hall. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Liz Bonnin's Wild Caribbean
programme.desc: The volcanic islands of the Lesser Antilles, built by eruptions and shaped by the ocean surrounding them, are some of the most biodiverse landscapes of the Caribbean, where humans have developed a special relationship with their wild surroundings. On Mayreau, Liz joins a team of residents repairing their vibrant coral, which has been damaged by disease. On neighbouring Union Island, she goes on patrol with a local environmental army to help protect the Union Island gecko, one of the smallest reptiles in the world. In St Vincent, Liz hikes one of the most active volcanoes in the region – La Soufriere – to find the brightly coloured St Vincent parrot. And in her ancestral home of Trinidad, she relives one of her most magnificent wildlife encounters: the flight of the scarlet ibis. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team travel to Londonderry for the first time in the show's history. Amongst the items under scrutiny are some very intricately produced hand-cut pictures, a cache of silver valued at over £100,000 and a cushion woven from human hair. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Flog It! comes from Ickworth House, a Georgian mansion in Suffolk built for the Earls of Bristol. Paul Martin is joined by experts Will Axon and Philip Serrell. Together the team pick out a selection of interesting antiques and collectables to be sold at a local auction. Will casts an appreciative eye over a piece of Martinware but will a miniature long case clock bought at the car boot for £1 prove to be the star find? Paul also heads to the Suffolk coast to explore the magical House in the Clouds in Thorpeness, a fantasy holiday village built in the early years of the 20th century. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: New: House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Catherine Bohart, Chesney Hawkes, Rebecca Keatley and Jason Mohammad take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, Michael Sheen. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games wheelie luggage, or will they be tempted by the House of Games skateboard? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Wanting a new start in Devon, a couple with a budget of £650,000 enlist Jules Hudson's house-hunting knowhow to find a detached family home with a large garden for their two young children and some income potential. Whilst in the county, Jules gets stuck into some woodcraft using nothing but steam to sculpt some impressive interior design pieces. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across the south west of the country to visit some of Britain's most exotic gardens, thanks to the warm and wet climate. On this journey, Monty also goes to some of the country's most historic gardens, as well as some challenging contemporary ones. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Why Sinkholes Collapse
programme.desc: On 24th September 2025, the main road outside one of Bangkok's major hospitals collapsed. The giant sinkhole, the size of two tennis courts, snapped water pipes, ripped down power lines, and swallowed two vehicles. During the day, it continued to grow, threatening the foundations of the hospital and forcing close to a thousand staff and patients to evacuate the building. Ampan Vimonvattana, vice dean of Vajira Hospital, witnessed the collapse: "The earth swallowed everything... it pulled the road surface, the soil, anything on top. Even the electrical poles got dragged down. It was really scary." Why Sinkholes Collapse explores cases of sinkholes in Godstone, Surrey, a collapse under a main road in Yashio City in Japan and the underground quarries that are beneath ten per cent of Paris to help explain why sinkholes occur and how they can be prevented. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Cunk on Cinema
programme.desc: Philomena Cunk heads to Hollywood, Los Angeles, for the final part of her staggeringly comprehensive history of cinema, where she accosts some of the people behind the biggest movies of recent years, from The Avengers to Transformers to the Flintstones film. She takes a look at Star Wars, Jurassic Park, Toy Story, the home video revolution, the rise of the blockbuster franchise and the state of cinema today. And with the rise of artificial intelligence, she asks the question: is Hollywood finished... or just about to be finished? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Film: Cabaret
programme.desc: Bob Fosse's award-winning musical, set in 1930s Berlin. A love affair develops between cabaret singer Sally Bowles and a naive young Englishman amid the city's decadent cafe society, during the gradual rise of German fascism. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: MasterChef: The Professionals
programme.desc: The four chefs who have survived the intensity of the heats are back in the kitchen. Now they must prove to Marcus and Monica that they have the consistency, confidence and creativity to take on the next level of the competition. First up is the invention test, where the chefs must put pistachio centre stage and show Marcus and Monica what they can do with it. It's an ingredient that naturally lends itself to pastry and desserts, but used cleverly in a savoury dish, it could give one chef the edge. Will anyone dare to take it somewhere unexpected? But the chefs aren't finished yet. Their next test takes them out of the kitchen and into the company of three of the country's most influential food critics: William Sitwell, Jimi Famurewa and, taking her place alongside them for the first time, Ixta Belfrage, a recipe developer and cookbook author who spent five years working at the Ottolenghi Test Kitchen. The chefs must cook a two-course menu that showcases their food, ideas and technical ability, knowing that every element will be scrutinised by some of the toughest palates in the business. This is their chance to prove they can produce food that excites and surprises. However, impressing three professional critics is no easy feat, and their verdicts could have a major bearing on what happens next. Back in the kitchen, Marcus and Monica must weigh up everything they have seen and tasted before deciding which chefs have done enough to progress. With only three places in knockout week available, one mistake, an underwhelming plate or a missed opportunity could make all the difference. Who will earn their place in the next stage – and whose journey ends here? The pressure is mounting as the chefs edge closer to the coveted MasterChef: The Professionals title. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Escaping Idi Amin
programme.desc: In August 1972, Idi Amin is 18 months into his dictatorship. Supporters hail the new president – a former boxer and soldier – as a saviour, and his rise to power is greeted with celebration and hope across Uganda. But beneath the apparent social harmony, resentment runs deep. Until 1962, Uganda had been a protectorate of the British – with the British very much at the top of the pile, Africans at the bottom and Asians in the middle. Despite ten years of independence, many Africans feel that they are denied opportunities to improve their position in society. Idi Amin decides to exploit their feelings and increase support for his regime. With one announcement from the president, the lives of 80,000 people in Uganda are changed forever. In a bid to cement his leadership, Idi Amin announces that all Ugandan Asians must leave the country within 90 days. Will they be able to flee on their British passports? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Great House Revival – The Old Herdsman's Cottage.
programme.desc: Entrepreneur Aoibheann has found the ideal location to retreat from her busy life in Galway – a modest derelict cottage in the heart of the Burren. But Aoibheann's creativity and plans for the cottage know no bounds, and if she can't rein in some of her ideas, will this renovation ever progress? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Finish Line

The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the £5,000 cash prize. (Senderinfo).

They have access to two beautiful and secluded loughs, set in over 130 acres of rolling countryside, and the private use of one rowing boat – what could possibly go wrong? Pike are wily fish, always hiding in the dark reeds and waiting to ambush their prey. Bob has a fail-safe method to try, but will the duo be able to outwit the elusive creatures? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Humanity's very survival depends on water. But global reserves are rapidly shrinking with no end in sight thanks to unmitigated climate change, population growth and poor resource management. Over two-thirds of the global population are faced with water stress, while millions have already been displaced by intense water scarcity which is now replacing oil as the most likely cause of global conflict. Hannah Fry learns about the different ways in which technology could help secure humanity's future water needs. She witnesses the effects of water scarcity in Kenya and learns about how technological solutions are currently being harnessed to reverse this dire situation. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc: Game show in which 24 players compete to score points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day. In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents this quiz show where a team of four – in this episode, friends Catherine, Lisa, Michelle and Helen – take on the Bridge of Lies. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will halve their money, step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
programme.desc: Sean Fletcher and Edith Bowman explore the Manchester Food and Drink Festival, meeting passionate producers of chilli sauce, Eritrean curries and Italian biscuits among the stalls. Onkar Singh Purewal discovers how it is possible to grow tea in the Vale of Glamorgan, while farmer Jim Smith gets stuck into some sticky sweets. The differences between dried, tinned, homemade and carton soup are revealed. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael's journey along the coast of Northumberland continues towards the Farne Islands, takes in the holy island of Lindisfarne, and finishes in England's northernmost town, Berwick-upon-Tweed. On the largest of the Farne Islands, Inner Farne, Michael pitches in to help rangers clear a toxic plant which is invading the island. It's so prolific that it's threatening the native plants upon which seabirds depend for nesting. From the mainland, Michael sets off on a two-mile pilgrimage along a single-track causeway, which twice a day is covered by the North Sea. His destination is the holy island of Lindisfarne. Michael discovers that the island was chosen in the seventh century by St Aidan as the site for a monastery. Northumbria's patron saint, St Cuthbert, later became bishop there. The vicar of the island today shows Michael a full-sized reproduction of the beautifully illuminated Lindisfarne Gospels, the originals of which are held in the British Museum. Back on the East Coast Main Line, Michael hugs the North Sea coast, crossing the River Tweed on Robert Stephenson's Royal Border Bridge to reach Britain's most northern town, Berwick-upon-Tweed. Struck by the variety of accents and dialects in the north east, Michael learns what distinguishes a Geordie from a Smoggie. Only two-and-a-half-miles from Scotland, Berwick-upon-Tweed has a turbulent past and an intriguing custom, dating back to the 15th century. Michael begs permission from the town's mayor to join horses and riders in a ceremony to mark the border between Scotland and England along a line agreed in 1438. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Liz Bonnin's Wild Caribbean
programme.desc: The South American coastline is one of the most populated regions of the Caribbean, yet just beyond the large cities lies untouched wilderness. And where the two meet, Liz discovers the unique relationships between people and nature – starting with her ancestral home, Trinidad, and it's world-renowned Carnival. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team are at Montacute House in Somerset. Among the finds are a set of chairs that witnessed the battle of Trafalgar aboard one of Nelson's ships, and a valuable postcard collection which began life as an occasional hobby. Also, a vicar's wife confesses to a weakness for vintage underwear. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Flog It! comes from the Museum of Science and Industry in Manchester. The show is packed with items from around the world, including an Inuit carving, a French book of butterflies and a ship that sailed the China seas. The experts are Anita Manning and Micheal Baggott. Paul Martin chances upon a rare and beautiful art book that is hugely contested in the saleroom. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: New: House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Catherine Bohart, Chesney Hawkes, Rebecca Keatley and Jason Mohammad take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, Michael Sheen. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games wheelie luggage, or will they be tempted by the House of Games skateboard? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Gardeners World Winter Specials
programme.desc: Winter may be closing in, but Adam Frost has thrown on his warm coat and is sharing some practical jobs and seasonal inspiration to keep gardens thriving through the colder months. From planting shrubs and creating a striking winter container to laying a brick path, there's plenty to be getting on with in preparation for spring. In Hertfordshire, Ashley Edwards is given an exclusive tour of a stunning walled garden. Rachel de Thame reveals her secrets for growing spectacular dahlias, while Joe Swift discovers an extraordinary garden in Dorset bursting with beauty and inspiring plant combinations. There's also an allotment gardener in North Yorkshire carrying forward a love of horticulture that runs in the family, and a garden designer shows how structure and form can transform a garden even in the depths of winter. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Film: Gladiator
programme.desc:
Nach einem glorreichen Sieg über die Germanen fällt der römische Feldherr Maximus (Russell Crowe) einer Intrige zum Opfer: Commodus (Joaquin Phoenix), der machthungrige Sohn des Kaisers (Richard Harris), erdrosselt seinen Vater und setzt auch den Krieger auf die Todesliste. 

Maximus entkommt nur knapp der Exekution, verliert seine Familie und wird als Sklave an eine Gladiatorenschule verkauft. Der Wunsch nach Rache hält Maximus am Leben. Der Kämpfer avanciert zum Star unter den Gladiatoren, und schließlich kämpft er im römischen Kolosseum vor seinem Erzfeind Commodus…

An diesem blutigen, finsteren und mit fünf Oscars gekrönten Werk von Ridley Scott („Blade Runner“) ist alles kolossal: die Schlacht in den Wäldern Germaniens, die Kulissen des alten Roms und die Schauspielkunst der beiden Widersacher.

programme.title: Film: Coriolanus
programme.desc:
Die Bürger Roms leiden unter Hunger und werden immer unzufriedener. Doch General Cajus Martius Coriolanus (Ralph Fiennes) zeigt wenig Mitgefühl – er steht offen auf der Seite der Reichen und verachtet das einfache Volk. Seine Arroganz führt schließlich zu einem blutigen Aufstand.

Trotzdem steigt Coriolanus politisch auf, denn seine Erfolge als Feldherr gegen die feindlichen Volsker bringen ihm Ansehen. Doch die mächtigen Politiker Roms sehen ihn als Bedrohung. Sie nutzen seinen Stolz, um die Bürger gegen ihn aufzuhetzen. Am Ende wird Coriolanus aus der Stadt verbannt.

Verbittert sucht er ausgerechnet bei seinem Erzfeind, dem Volsker Tullus Aufidius (Gerard Butler), Zuflucht. Er schließt sich ihm an – mit einem gemeinsamen Ziel: Rom zu zerstören. Doch als seine Mutter Volumnia davon erfährt, fleht sie ihn an, den Angriff zu stoppen. Coriolanus steht vor einer unmöglichen Entscheidung: Soll er seiner Familie treu bleiben oder seine Ehre bei den Volskern wahren?

Shakespeares kraftvolle Sprache macht einen ganz besoffen vor Glück, einige Szenen sind großer Tragödienstoff (z.B. das Flehen der Mutter, toll gespielt von Vanessa Redgrave). Aber die Verlegung des Stücks in die Gegenwart (Drehort: Belgrad) knirscht, die aktuellen Bezüge bleiben meist Behauptung. Zudem überreißt Fiennes sein Spiel.

programme.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
programme.desc: In the fourth leg, the teams enter a new frontier, Australia. The sixth largest country on the planet and home to eight distinct climate zones, it's a land of extreme contrasts. Language barriers may have evaporated, but in their place is a new challenge, the budget, as the country delivers all teams a financial reality check. The teams descend on the fourth checkpoint in the tightest race yet, with a foot race to the sign-in book. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: A Course Called Ireland
programme.desc: After a hair-raising drive across the Conor Pass and a spot of seaside silliness hitting golf balls into the ocean, Bill bids farewell to Chris O'Dowd. In County Clare, Bill and Tom's attempt to sneak unnoticed into a hurling match goes awry, before an emotional reunion recalls an unforgettable act of kindness. Then, a chance invitation in Ballybunion leads to a freezing Atlantic challenge. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Super Happy Magic Forest
programme.desc: Mr Friendlyface is particularly tetchy this morning. He is packing for a skiing trip, but a dragon has pinched his golden fleece, and he urgently needs the heroes to quest it back – how else will he stay warm and cosy on the slopes? However, when the heroes accidentally agree to let his niece Trixie tag along with them, they fear that her clumsiness and lack of hero skills will ruin everything. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings: World Tour.
Winx Club – The Magic Is Back
Blue Peter: Secret Santa Showdown, Greg James and Festive Crafts.
Gardeners' World Winter Specials
programme.desc: Winter may be closing in, but Adam Frost has thrown on his warm coat and is sharing some practical jobs and seasonal inspiration to keep gardens thriving through the colder months. From planting shrubs and creating a striking winter container to laying a brick path, there's plenty to be getting on with in preparation for spring. In Hertfordshire, Ashley Edwards is given an exclusive tour of a stunning walled garden. Rachel de Thame reveals her secrets for growing spectacular dahlias, while Joe Swift discovers an extraordinary garden in Dorset bursting with beauty and inspiring plant combinations. There's also an allotment gardener in North Yorkshire carrying forward a love of horticulture that runs in the family, and a garden designer shows how structure and form can transform a garden even in the depths of winter. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Life in a Cottage Garden with Carol Klein.
programme.desc: Plantswoman Carol Klein shares with us a year in her garden at Glebe Cottage in north Devon. Carol has looked after her garden for over 30 years, each with its own rewards and delights, as well as problems and challenges. Follow Carol as her garden grows, flourishes, dies and is reborn. The first episode covers January and February. The frosts have not yet released their grip on the garden, and the devastation of a hard winter is scattered all around. There is much to do – cutting back, preparing the soil and planting garlic. The first green shoots of the year begin to appear as drifts of snowdrops carpet the woodland floor and hellebores reveal their ravishing colours. A local woodsman joins Carol to lay a native hedge. Slowly, the first signs of spring appear. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Naturewatch
programme.desc: Nature is full of extraordinary surprises, and Chris Packham, Kyle Thomas and Megan McCubbin are uncovering some of its more curious mysteries. Why do foxes' eyes shine in the dark? How did fish farts almost cause an international diplomatic incident? Does ivy really damage the trees it climbs? And how exactly do sea anemones deliver their sting? Together, they get to the bottom of these fascinating wildlife questions, with plenty of surprising discoveries along the way. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Film: Whisky Galore! (1948)
programme.desc: Classic Ealing comedy about a whisky-laden ship that runs aground off the coast of the Outer Hebrides during the Second World War. The local islanders have depleted their supply of the amber nectar and are overjoyed at the thought of stocking up again. But it is Sunday, and the teetotallers object to making free with the unexpected cargo. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Marcus Wareing's Tales from a Kitchen Garden.
programme.desc: Marcus makes plans to expand the smallholding's herb patch. A trip to Gloucestershire to see the UK's largest herb collection shows that even someone as experienced as Marcus can still learn a lot about ingredients. Back at the smallholding, gardener Anatoli shows Marcus how to look after the bees and harvest the honey, and Marcus brings in some junior chefs to get inspired in the way the kitchen garden is inspiring him. Once the new herbs are in place, Marcus cooks up a herby feast for the people who have helped him along the way. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: A beautiful building in Bath. Martin meets a couple who have bought a flat in a period, listed building, and luckily for them, they own the flat below too. In West Yorkshire, Martel meets two pals hoping to turn four flats into six! (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Film: Kelly's Heroes
programme.desc: Zweiter Weltkrieg: Per Zufall erfährt US-Soldat Kelly (Clint Eastwood), dass die Deutschen in einer Bank in Lothringen einen Goldschatz deponiert haben. Mit einem Haufen schräger Vögel (u. a. Telly Savalas, Harry Dean Stanton und Donald Sutherland) gibt er dem Kitzel des Verbotenen nach und bricht in geklauten Panzern ins Feindesland auf…\n\nDer satirische Mix aus „Das dreckige Dutzend“ (1967) und den Italowestern jener Jahre ist ein schräger Spaß mit tollen Thrillereffekten und großen Explosionen. Passend dazu veralbert der Soundtrack von Lalo Schifrin („Mission: Impossible“) den „Morricone“-Sound der Sergio-Leone-Western.

programme.title: Final Score
programme.desc: Jason Mohammad and guests bring you all the goals, latest news, analysis, reaction and interviews from the afternoon's biggest football matches. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Film: A Bridge Too Far
programme.desc: Im September 1944 springen in den Niederlanden 35.000 alliierte Fallschirmjäger hinter den feindlichen Linien ab, um sechs Rheinbrücken zu besetzen. Doch im Zielgebiet liegen starke deutsche Panzerverbände. Das Unternehmen „Market Garden“ endet in einem Fiasko, bei dem 17.000 Soldaten sterben…\n\n„Gandhi“-Regisseur Attenborough († 2014) drehte mit Stars in Kompaniestärke: Sean Connery, Michael Caine, Anthony Hopkins, Hardy Krüger, Robert Redford und andere standen für das aufwändige Schlachtengemälde stramm.

programme.title: U2 at the BBC
programme.desc: Bringing together some of U2's most memorable BBC performances, including early songs like their first Top 40 hit Fire on Top of the Pops in 1981, I Will Follow from a 1982 appearance on teen magazine show Something Else, and Two Hearts Beat as One from a rarely seen visit to The Kenny Everett Television Show in 1983. Other highlights include their 2011 set at Glastonbury, which featured classic tracks like Sunday Bloody Sunday, Where the Streets Have No Name and Pride (In the Name of Love), and a 2009 performance of Vertigo that wasn't just at the BBC, but on it too – with the band singing on top of the roof of Broadcasting House. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: U2: Live on the BBC at Tate Modern
programme.desc: Global titans U2 perform at the Tate Modern in London for a truly unique live collaboration of music and art. Fifty years since the Dublin band formed at secondary school, the legendary four-piece return with their 16th album, Carnaval De Luz. For one night, they perform songs from the record and classic favourites, including Pride (In the Name of Love), Beautiful Day and With or Without You, visually accompanied by 77 Million Paintings, an artwork by producer, artist and long-time friend and collaborator of the band Brian Eno. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: U2: Tracks Of My Years
programme.desc: Bono, The Edge, Adam Clayton and Larry Mullen Jr, aka U2, join Vernon Kay to choose ten songs from their lives as they release their new album, Carnaval De Luz, their first in nine years. Fifty years since the band formed as teenagers at Mount Temple Comprehensive School in Dublin in 1976, U2 are now recognised as one of the biggest bands in history earning their spot in the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame in 2005. They've won more Grammy Awards than any other band in history, picking up 22 awards, while their seven awards for Best International Act is a Brit Award record that they share with Prince and Michael Jackson. Alongside the critical acclaim, U2 are one of the biggest selling acts of all time with 175 million album sales to their name and their U2 360 tour became the highest-grossing tour of all time while pioneering a more immersive concert experience for fans. Bono and Adam Clayton both appeared on the Band Aid record, before a breakout performance for the group the following year at the Wembley leg of Live Aid. Later in their career they headlined Glastonbury's pyramid stage in 2011 and became the first act to perform at the iconic Las Vegas Sphere in 2023. Now the band are back with a brand-new album, Carnaval de Luz, their first album in three years, alongside a world tour in 2027 marking their first UK stadium shows in a decade. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Lost Neanderthals
programme.desc: The Mandrin Cave in southern France has been attracting the attention of archaeologists for 30 years. The cave was regularly occupied in prehistoric times, and a remarkable record of human habitation going back thousands of years has been preserved by its soils. In 2015, the remains of a Neanderthal were uncovered, and the archaeological evidence points to this individual, named Thorin, living in close proximity to newly arrived Homo sapiens. This documentary follows an international team of scientists as they discover and investigate precious relics of the Palaeolithic period, resulting in groundbreaking revelations about the human populations of around 50,000 years ago as researchers uncover some of the secrets of the Mandrin Cave. (Senderinfo).

programme.sub-title: Sandy Welch Remembers... Our Mutual Friend

programme.title: Yellowstone: Wildest Winter to Blazing Summer
The Eagle Has Landed
programme.desc: Ende 1943 glaubt selbst SS-Führer Himmler (Donald Pleasence) nicht mehr an den "Endsieg". Eine letzte Chance sieht er in der Entführung des britischen Premierministers Churchill. Ein Kommando unter Luftwaffenoffizier Steiner (Michael Caine) soll ihn aus England herausholen. Der irische Untergrundkämpfer Liam Devlin (Donald Sutherland) hilft den Deutschen…\n\nHochkarätig besetzte Action von John Sturges („Die glorreichen Sieben“).

programme.title: Blue Velvet
programme.desc:
Auf einer Wiese findet Student Jeffrey (Kyle MacLachlan) ein abgeschnittenes Ohr. Er trägt es brav zur Polizei und spielt danach selbst Detektiv: Während seine Freundin, die säuerliche Polizeichef-Tochter Sandy (Laura Dern) im Wagen wartet, steigt Jeffrey in die Wohnung der Nachtclubsängerin Dorothy ein, die in den Fall verwickelt ist. Natürlich wird er ertappt. 

Schon die Begegnung mit Dorothy (Isabella Rossellini) fordert dem naiven Jüngling einiges ab, als er aber ihrem Lover (Dennis Hopper) in die Arme läuft, lernt er ganz neue Dimensionen von Bosheit und Perversion kennen. 

Dennis Hopper, anerkannter Film-Sonderling seit dem Biker-Kultfilm „Easy Rider“, spielt hier einen der schillerndsten Schurken aller Zeiten, das personifizierte Böse. Ausnahmeregisseur David Lynch („The Straight Story“) braut ein tückisches Wechselbad aus Faszination und Abscheu zusammen.

Country Queens at the BBC
programme.desc: Classic female country stars in action on a variety of BBC studio shows and featuring Bobbie Gentry, Anne Murray, Emmylou Harris, Tammy Wynette, Billie Jo Spears, Crystal Gayle, Taylor Swift, Lucinda Williams with Mary Chapin Carpenter and more. programme.title: Davis v Taylor: The '85 Black Ball Final
Antoine de Caunes : la vie "rêvée" d'un enfant du rock
programme.desc: Antoine de Caunes a traversé plus de quatre décennies du PAF… Un peu comme Tintin l'aurait fait au pays des pixels… Et de fait, tout le monde connaît Antoine de Caunes. "Il est le seul survivant de la chaine cryptée. Et c'est un paradoxe. Car il n'a rien fait pour recevoir un tel César d'honneur. C'est presque tout le contraire même. Au-delà de sa personnalité, la réponse est en partie dans le fait qu'il nous a été indispensable pour franchir ces décennies folles de bouleversement social, politique et culturel qui viennent de s'écouler. Il n'avait pourtant pas de plan de carrière. Il est allé là où le vent, ses goûts, et la chance l'ont mené, à droite, à gauche, un peu partout, mais rarement au même endroit. Il a pratiqué un, deux, trois, quatre métiers dans le cœur du PAF hexagonal jusqu'à créer une sorte de PROFESSION(S), la sienne : Antoine de Caunes. Antoine est un lanceur d'alertes culturelles avec un recul, une ironie, une impertinence qui a résonné dans les baffles des années 1980, 1990, 2000, 2010." Autour d'Antoine, des figures qui l'ont accompagné, croisé, témoignent et nous confient les détails de l'aventure. Parmi celles-ci, Paul Smith, Asia Argento, Doria Tillier, Léa Drucker, José Garcia, Roschdy Zem, Karine Viard, Pierre Lescure, Emma de Caunes, Jamie Hewlet et Damon Albarn, Jean-Paul Gaultier, Alexandre Astier, Philippe Djian, Stephan Eicher, Elsa Zylberstein, Monsieur Poulpe, ET… Bruce Springsteen ! (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Le cercle
programme.desc: LE CERCLE est depuis plus de vingt ans la seule émission de débats critiques entièrement dédiée au cinéma, offrant des joutes enflammées, joyeuses et sans complaisance sur les films à l'affiche. "Le rendez-vous cinéphile de CANAL+ est présenté par Lily Bloom entourée de Philippe Rouyer et de toute une bande de passionnés libres et exigeants : Frédéric Mercier, Ava Cahen, Simon Riaux, Lucile Commeaux, Arthur Bouet, Perrine Quennesson, Sophie Grech, Charles Bodson mais aussi Adrien Denouette. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Clique
programme.desc: Nouvel horaire, nouvelle formule pour CLIQUE, présenté par Mouloud Achour. A 19h45 Pauline Clavière ouvre le bal avec "Le JT de Clique" , le journal avec tout ce qu'il fallait cliquer dans la journée. Mouloud Achour revient à son exercice signature, le "Clique X" face à face iconique, entretien au long cours avec la personnalité du jour. Un invité sociétal viendra ensuite nous éclairer sur le monde actuel, toujours en clair et en direct ! (Senderinfo).

programme.title: En aparté
programme.desc: Des stars d'Hollywood à la scène musicale, du sport à l'humour, en passant par la mode, EN APARTÉ accueille ceux qui font l'actualité. Seul dans l'intimité d'un appartement, sans public et guidé par la voix de Nathalie Lévy, chaque invité se laisse porter par un échange, des images, des objets et les souvenirs qui jalonnent une rencontre unique en son genre. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Inventeur Gadget – Les 1000 vies de Jean Chalopin
programme.desc: Jean Chalopin quitte l'école tôt, à 13 ans et demi, effectue des petits boulots et écrit des poèmes. Il raconte comment, de la distribution de prospectus publicitaires, puis de la production de spots publicitaires, il en est venu à diriger le premier studio de dessin animé en France. Sa société, DIC, fondée en 1971, devient l'un des plus grands producteurs mondiaux de séries d'animation pour la jeunesse, grâce à une alliance inattendue avec des studios au Japon. Ainsi naissent les fameux ULYSSE 31, LES MYSTERIEUSES CITES D'OR et INSPECTEUR GADGET. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Inventeur Gadget – Les 1000 vies de Jean Chalopin
programme.sub-title: Jean ou les conquérants de la pierre
programme.desc: En 1986, Jean Chalopin rencontre sa future épouse, la mannequin singapourienne Ethel Fong. Un an plus tard, il revend ses parts de DIC Entreprise, premier producteur mondial des dessins animés cultes ULYSSE 31, LES MYSTERIEUSES CITES D'OR et INSPECTEUR GADGET. Son projet suivant, lancé en 1989, se solde par son premier échec : Planète Magique, un parc d'attractions créées à partir de ses succès d'animation, en plein cœur de Paris. Il s'investit alors pleinement dans la rénovation du château médiéval de Farcheville qu'il a acheté. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Inventeur Gadget – Les 1000 vies de Jean Chalopin
programme.desc: Jean Chalopin et sa famille se sont établis aux Bahamas. CASINO ROYAL est tourné en partie sur la propriété qu'il a fait bâtir. Le créateur d'INSPECTEUR GADGET se retrouve à la tête de la banque Deltec, spécialisée dans la gestion de fortunes. Il se passionne pour sa nouvelle activité, investissant dans la crypto-monnaie, via l'entreprise FTX dont la faillite va l'affecter, et également le secteur de la biotechnologie. Jean Chalopin ne cesse d'entreprendre. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: L'hebd'Hollywood
programme.desc: Entre événements, indiscrétions et exclusivités, le journaliste Didier Allouch propose chaque semaine, depuis Los Angeles, un décryptage très personnel de l'actualité du cinéma américain. News sur les tournages, tendances, films en salles, stars : la cité des Anges livre tous ses secrets. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: En aparté
programme.desc: Nouvelle saison et nouveaux invités pour EN APARTÉ avec Nathalie Levy qui revient du lundi au vendredi à 20H30 en clair sur CANAL+. Collection de moments privilégiés et suspendus, intimes et éclairants, émouvants et drôles, EN APARTÉ, c'est près de 4 millions de visionnages sur myCANAL et 130 invités prestigieux la saison passée. Et la nouvelle programmation s'annonce toujours aussi épatante ! "La saison dernière a été riche en moments forts, de la présence exceptionnelle de Naomi Campbell, Eva Longoria ou Josh Brolin, des pas de danse de Valérie Lemercier aux notes de piano de François Civil en passant par l'émotion de François Cluzet, sans oublier la participation événement de la trop rare Isabelle Adjani, entre autres. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: L'enfant du désert
programme.desc: Sun Del Renaque, 15 ans, vient d'écrire un livre à succès, inspiré d'une histoire que son grand-père lui racontait ; celle du petit Hadara, un enfant touareg âgé de 2 ans, perdu dans l'immensité du désert et sauvé d'une tempête par un couple d'autruches. Invitée à séjourner dans la région du Sahara, la jeune fille découvre que l'histoire d'Hadara est peut-être bien plus qu'un simple conte pour enfant. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Michael
programme.desc:
Joe Jackson, ein strenger und machthungriger Vater, drillt seine Söhne zu Musikern und macht aus ihnen die Jackson 5. Die große Sensation: der kleine Michael. Zu Hause bekommt er aber trotz seines Erfolgs vom Papa nur Schläge mit dem Gürtel. Als junger Erwachsener steigt er mit Hits wie „Billie Jean“, „Thriller“ und „Bad“ an die Spitze der weltweiten Bekanntheit und zementiert sein Image als „King of Pop“… 

Michael Jacksons realer Neffe Jaafar Jackson ist als Imitat seines Onkels eine Sensation. In den besten Konzert- und Showszenen glaubt man gar, die Musiklegende wieder vor sich zu sehen. Ansonsten ist dieses Biopic eine umstrittene Angelegenheit: Technisch makellos wird die Musikindustrie einer vergangenen Ära heraufbeschworen. Doch der Film endet auch im Jahr 1987 – und spart damit die Missbrauchsvorwürfe aus, mit denen sich Jackson im späteren Verlauf seines Lebens konfrontiert sah. 

Auch sein tragischer Tod oder Themen wie seine Medikamentenabhängigkeit kommen nicht vor. Stattdessen inszeniert Antoine Fuqua („Training Day“) eine unkritische Heldenverehrung, die die Jackson-Erben freuen dürfte, Kritiker aber auch kopfschüttelnd zurücklassen wird. Man darf sich an alldem stören – und trotzdem ist es legitim, sich von den unsterblichen Songs und ihrer perfekten filmischen Aufbereitung einfach mitreißen zu lassen. Für Fans des Stars ist das ein unschätzbar wertvoller Nostalgietrip.

programme.title: Police Flash 80
programme.desc: Paris, années 1980. Quand son coéquipier Johnny Lansky est retrouvé assassiné, l'inspecteur Yvon Kastendeuch prend la tête d'une brigade spéciale antidrogue : la Police Flash 80. Mais ce flic aux méthodes dépassées va devoir diriger trois jeunes flics, Guilaine, analyste rigoureuse, Roberto, maître de l'infiltration, et Marfoud, expert en écoutes. Malgré ce choc des générations, ils vont tenter de démanteler un trafic d'héroïne qui ravage les cités. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: French Pop
programme.desc: La French pop, c'est ainsi qu'on appelle notre musique à l'international. C'est de la chanson française, du rap français, de l'électro, le rock de Téléphone, la fantaisie surréaliste de Gaby, le clip "Cargo de nuit" de Mondino ou celui culte des Rita Mitsouko entré dans les collections du Moma, mais aussi des hymnes hurlés à tue-tête dans les boums comme "Disparue" , "C'est la ouate" ou "Voyage voyage" . FRENCH POP, L'ALBUM DES ANNÉES 80, c'est un peu de tout ça réuni. Un voyage musical dans le temps qui donne envie de chanter et de danser ! (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Les génies de la nature
programme.desc: Dans un territoire grand comme la Bretagne, à la frontière des Balkans, la Slovénie concentre une densité du vivant qui défie l'entendement. Ours, loups, lynx, rapaces et pollinisateurs en tout genre peuplent les vallées boisées et les prairies alpines qui couvrent près de 60 % du territoire. Plus singulier encore, un réseau souterrain de galeries s'étend sur des centaines de kilomètres sous les plateaux calcaires, abritant une faune cavernicole parmi les plus riches et les plus endémiques du monde. Accompagnée de biologistes, de naturalistes et de chercheurs qui consacrent leur vie à ces espèces, Marat part à la découverte d'animaux et d'organismes qui incarnent, chacun à leur façon, le génie évolutif du vivant. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Antoine de Caunes : la vie "rêvée" d'un enfant du rock
programme.desc: Antoine de Caunes a traversé plus de quatre décennies du PAF… Un peu comme Tintin l'aurait fait au pays des pixels… Et de fait, tout le monde connaît Antoine de Caunes. "Il est le seul survivant de la chaine cryptée. Et c'est un paradoxe. Car il n'a rien fait pour recevoir un tel César d'honneur. C'est presque tout le contraire même. Au-delà de sa personnalité, la réponse est en partie dans le fait qu'il nous a été indispensable pour franchir ces décennies folles de bouleversement social, politique et culturel qui viennent de s'écouler. Il n'avait pourtant pas de plan de carrière. Il est allé là où le vent, ses goûts, et la chance l'ont mené, à droite, à gauche, un peu partout, mais rarement au même endroit. Il a pratiqué un, deux, trois, quatre métiers dans le cœur du PAF hexagonal jusqu'à créer une sorte de PROFESSION(S), la sienne : Antoine de Caunes. Antoine est un lanceur d'alertes culturelles avec un recul, une ironie, une impertinence qui a résonné dans les baffles des années 1980, 1990, 2000, 2010." Autour d'Antoine, des figures qui l'ont accompagné, croisé, témoignent et nous confient les détails de l'aventure. Parmi celles-ci, Paul Smith, Asia Argento, Doria Tillier, Léa Drucker, José Garcia, Roschdy Zem, Karine Viard, Pierre Lescure, Emma de Caunes, Jamie Hewlet et Damon Albarn, Jean-Paul Gaultier, Alexandre Astier, Philippe Djian, Stephan Eicher, Elsa Zylberstein, Monsieur Poulpe, ET… Bruce Springsteen ! (Senderinfo).

programme.desc: Paris, années 1980. programme.title: Deep Water
programme.desc: Alors qu'il survole les Îles Mariannes, un incendie se déclare dans la soute du vol 140 de la Northeastern Airlines qui devait relier Los Angeles à Shanghai avec 257 passagers à bord. Le commandant de bord se trouve contraint d'opérer un amerrissage d'urgence. Les rescapés se retrouvent bientôt dans des eaux infestées de requins. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Running Man
programme.desc:
Amerika in der Zukunft. Statt der Regierung kontrolliert mittlerweile ein Fernsehsender, das „Network“ genannt, den faschistischen Staat, steuert Politik und Nachrichten gleichermaßen. Der Großteil der Menschen lebt in Armut. Aufstiegschancen hat nur, wer an mörderischen Spiel- und Realityshows des Networks teilnimmt. Um Geld für seine kranke Tochter aufzutreiben, lässt sich Ben Richards auf die gefährlichste aller Shows ein: „The Running Man“. Wer dort teilnimmt, ist für 30 Tage vogelfrei. 

Professionelle Jäger und der Rest der Bevölkerung dürfen einen durch das ganze Land jagen. Das Ziel: solange wie möglich überleben. Schafft man den Monat, winken Reichtum und Macht. Doch schnell ahnt Richards, dass das Spiel getürkt ist. Während er durch die USA flieht, regt sich Widerstand – mit ihm als Symbolfigur der Rebellion… 

Näher am Originalroman als die 1987er-Verfilmung mit Arnold Schwarzenegger, ist das flotte Remake von Edgar Wright („Hot Fuzz“) eine bissige Satire auf ein gewaltbereites Amerika, das nur noch vom Reality-TV zusammengehalten wird. Wright setzt auf turboschnelle, virtuose Verfolgungsjagden und Schusswechsel und hält sich mit politischem Subtext nicht zurück. Nicht alles fließt perfekt ineinander, aber es ist erfrischend, aus Hollywoods Blockbuster-Schmiede etwas so Anarchisches zu bekommen.

Seul dans l'intimité d'un appartement, sans public et guidé par la voix de Nathalie Lévy, chaque invité se laisse porter par un échange, des images, des objets et les souvenirs qui jalonnent une rencontre unique en son genre. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Clique
programme.desc: Nouvel horaire, nouvelle formule pour CLIQUE, présenté par Mouloud Achour. A 19h45 Pauline Clavière ouvre le bal avec "Le JT de Clique" , le journal avec tout ce qu'il fallait cliquer dans la journée. Mouloud Achour revient à son exercice signature, le "Clique X" face à face iconique, entretien au long cours avec la personnalité du jour. Un invité sociétal viendra ensuite nous éclairer sur le monde actuel, toujours en clair et en direct ! (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Juste une illusion
programme.desc: La banlieue parisienne des années 1980. La famille Dayan vit au rythme des tensions et des petits joies du quotidien. Yves dissimule son licenciement, Sandrine se forme à l'informatique pour évoluer professionnellement, Arnaud, l'aîné, revend des cassettes rares en cachette, et Vincent, à l'approche de sa bar-mitsva, tombe amoureux. Chacun cherche sa place dans un monde en pleine mutation. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Chers parents
programme.desc: Convoqués en urgence par leurs parents, Pierre, Louise et Jules débarquent paniqués dans la maison de famille, craignant une mauvaise nouvelle. Quel soulagement lorsque la fratrie apprend qu'ils viennent de gagner le gros lot du loto. Seulement voilà, les retraités n'ont aucunement l'intention de partager leur gain… Les enfants n'auront rien ! (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Cocorico 2
programme.desc: Les Bouvier-Sauvage et les Martin préparent le mariage d'Alice et de François, que les deux tourtereaux espèrent sans friction ni querelle. Frédéric Bouvier-Sauvage et Gerhard Martin acceptent de mettre leurs différends de côté. Mais, rappelé par le labo, Frédéric découvre, à son grand désespoir, qu'en plus de ses 15% de Cherokee, il serait Turc à 85% ! Les préparatifs ne s'annoncent pas de tout repos. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Marsupilami
programme.desc: David, père de famille divorcé, a commis une une faute professionnelle. Pour se faire pardonner, il doit rapporter à son patron un mystérieux colis d'Amérique latine. Mais tout ne se passe pas comme prévu. Quand le contenu du colis s'avère être un petit animal d'une rareté incroyable, David se retrouve embarqué, avec sa famille, dans une aventure rocambolesque qui le dépasse. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: La boîte à questions
programme.desc: Sacrifiant au rituel d'une émission au format maintenant bien connu, une célébrité répond aux questions qui lui sont posées en off. C'est une interview aussi décalée que décontractée qui en découle. Les invités se révèlent souvent sous un autre angle, avec spontanéité. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Super plan

programme.title: Artus – Le Show XXL
programme.desc: Artus relève un défi inédit : devenir le premier humoriste à jouer son spectacle à La Plénitude Arena, la plus grande salle couverte d'Europe. "Celui qui a conquis le public à travers ses one-man-shows, le cinéma et ses créations audacieuses à la télé, s'attaque cette fois à une scène démesurée, taillée pour les plus grands concerts et événements sportifs. Avec son humour sans filtre, sa générosité et son sens du spectacle, Artus promet une soirée hors normes, entre rire XXL et communion géante avec le public." Un événement historique, à la croisée du stand-up et du show à l'américaine — et une nouvelle preuve que l'humour français n'a plus peur des très grands formats. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Gérald le Conquérant
programme.desc: Gérald gère une ferme pédagogique en Normandie. Pour vanter sa région, il a une idée lumineuse : ouvrir un parc à thème en l'honneur de Guillaume le Conquérant, le plus grand guerrier de l'histoire selon lui. Un documentariste décide de suivre Gérald pas à pas, à mesure qu'il met sur pied ce projet titanesque..., même si, pour l'instant, le parc n'existe que dans la tête de Gérard. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: French Pop
programme.desc: La French pop, c'est ainsi qu'on appelle notre musique à l'international. C'est de la chanson française, du rap français, de l'électro, le rock de Téléphone, la fantaisie surréaliste de Gaby, le clip "Cargo de nuit" de Mondino ou celui culte des Rita Mitsouko entré dans les collections du Moma, mais aussi des hymnes hurlés à tue-tête dans les boums comme "Disparue" , "C'est la ouate" ou "Voyage voyage" .
